summary: Elong Power Holding Limited, a Beijing-domiciled NASDAQ-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 5, 2026, disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiary Elong Power (Beijing) Co., Ltd. entered a three-year energy storage equipment cooperation agreement with an unnamed domestic grid-side storage developer. The procurement framework is valued at no less than RMB2 billion (~US$300 million), with a first purchase contract of at least RMB300 million (~US$45 million) slated for January 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or ownership terms are stated; this is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation.
